title: delivery.fact.delivered v1 payload
description: ADR-0011 D1 — the irreversible physical fact that custody passed to the receiver (ADR-0003). Shipment consumes it to close the journey; Finance correlates it with the COD fact. Carries no delivery code, no ID imagery and no receiver contact detail.

stop_id.description: DeliveryStop aggregate id; MUST equal envelope aggregate_id.

delivering_driver_id.description: Whose custody ended. Every custody change is attributable (SEC-09).

verified_by.description: How the person at the door was proven. The code itself is never published.

inspection_outcome.description: A refusal is not a delivery and uses delivery.fact.attempt_failed.

seal_outcome.description: Present when the merchant bought the packaging add-on. A broken seal never reaches this event.

amount_collected_minor_units.description: Exact minor units. Absent for prepaid.

photo_media_count.description: How many delivery photos exist. The references themselves stay in Delivery.

then.description: v6.3 p.31 — a COD parcel is not Delivered unless payment was actually collected.
